<div class="card-body">
'''Ickabel G'ont''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊イッカベル・ゴント</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手は隣接する位置カードでフォース消耗を行う場合には、Xフォースを支払わなければならない。X＝イッカベルと同じロケーションにいるミュージシャンの人数である。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ickabel-Gont-PSA-164793240.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス男性のミュージシャン。お気に入りの曲は“アクアナの涙”（たぶん自分のファンファーレの聞かせどころがあるから）。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ickabel G'ont.

'''Card text:'''
When the opponent Force drains at an adjacent location card, X Force must be paid. X = the number of musicians at the same location as Ickabel.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. His favorite song is "Tears of Aquanna" (maybe because it features his fanfar).

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese counts musicians at Ickabel's location; the English counts other musicians present with him.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ickabel G'ont]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
